title: Root Cause Analysis — agent analysis input
description: The reasoning half of a root cause report. Written by the Root Cause Analyst agent to .github/.pipeline-context/rca/<issue_id>.analysis.json after reading the evidence bundle, then consumed by scripts/render-root-cause.js. Every claim made here must be traceable to the evidence bundle.

issue_id.description: Must match the issue_id in the evidence bundle, e.g. ISSUE-001.

confidence.description: High only when the evidence bundle alone proves the cause; Low when a hypothesis still needs runtime confirmation.

plain_summary.description: One sentence a non-engineer would understand, naming what stops working and why. Rendered as the quote under the title. Keep class and method names out of it. Falls back to `summary` if omitted, but supplying it is what makes the report readable to a non-engineer.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what breaks, where, and why. Written for an engineer who has not read the issue.

expected_flow.description: Optional but recommended. The steps of the correct behaviour, in order — e.g. ['Request arrives', 'Controller delegates to the service', 'Service saves the record', '201 Created returned']. Rendered side by side with the causal chain as a green/red comparison diagram, which is the fastest way to show a reader what went wrong. Keep each step under about 45 characters and match the number of steps roughly to the causal chain.

statement.description: One sentence naming the single defect. No symptoms, no fix.

defect_location.description: Repo-relative file path with line number, e.g. department-service/src/.../DepartmentController.java:25

explanation.description: Why that defect produces the reported symptom, citing the specific evidence (call edges, endpoints, source lines) that supports it.

causal_chain.description: Ordered trigger-to-symptom steps. Rendered as a numbered list and a Mermaid flowchart.

detail.description: One sentence describing what happens at this step.

contributing_factors.description: Conditions that let the defect reach or survive in the codebase (missing tests, no static analysis gate, copied pattern, absent pagination convention). Not the cause itself.

narrative.description: What this means operationally: which users/flows/services degrade, and how. Must be consistent with the affected area recorded in the evidence bundle.

severity_rationale.description: Why the reported severity is right, or why it should change.

approach.description: The corrective change and why it resolves the root cause rather than the symptom.

change.description: What to change in that file.

code_sketch.description: Optional illustrative Java snippet. Must not be presented as an applied patch.

verification.description: Concrete, checkable steps proving the fix works — the test to add, the request to replay, the metric to watch.

prevention.description: Guardrails that stop this class of defect recurring.

open_questions.description: Anything the available evidence could not settle. Use this instead of guessing.
